content: We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id (integer) for the template that when applied to the molecule reproduces the reaction described. The search returned empty list, meaning no template matches criteria. Maybe need to adjust criteria. The reaction: chalcone cyclization to flavanone. The target molecule is flavanone? SMILES given O=C1CCc2c(ccc(c2)C3=CC=CC=C3)O1 which is a flavanone (2-phenyl-2,3-dihydro-4H-1-benzopyran-4-one). The forward reaction: chalcone (aryl-α,β-unsaturated ketone) + base -> flavanone via intramolecular Michael addition forming C-C and C-O, breaking C-O (maybe phenolic OH?). Functional groups broken: aromatic hydroxyls (phenol OH) and ketones (the carbonyl of chalcone?). Formed: ether oxygens (the new heterocycle). So we need a retrosynthetic template that breaks C-C and C-O bonds, forms C-O bond? Actually retrosynthesis: break the new C-C and C-O formed, and break the ether O? The template likely corresponds to intramolecular Michael addition. We need to find template ID that matches. Since search returned none, maybe need to search without bond criteria, just functional groups.
